rationale.edition: OSS — all 13 changed file paths are in standard OSS locations under web/src/ and tests/ui-testing/. None touch enterprise-owned directories (enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/). While the Service Graph toolbar tab is gated behind v-if="config.isEnterprise == 'true'", that is a runtime guard in OSS code, not an enterprise-owned path — the authoritative path-based classification therefore resolves to oss.
rationale.skip: Not skipped — the diff adds new toolbar tabs (Service Graph, Services Catalog) on the Traces SearchBar and new in-page view rendering in Index.vue, which are user-facing UI changes. No explicit opt-out label or skip comment is present in the trigger inputs. The change does not qualify as docs-only, CI-only, or comment/test-data-only.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted — the diff adds a unified view toggle (OToggleGroup) in SearchBar.vue with Service Graph, Traces, Spans, and Services Catalog modes, and in-page view rendering for those modes in Index.vue (ServiceGraph and ServicesCatalog components). This is a new user interaction flow on the Traces page that needs end-to-end verification of tab switching, URL state (?tab=), search context carry-over, and the rail flyout's continued standalone-route behavior.
rationale.area: Traces — the bulk of the UI changes live in web/src/plugins/traces/ (SearchBar.vue, Index.vue, and their .spec.ts files). The dev-authored E2E spec lands at tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Traces/traces-toolbar-tabs.spec.js, and the enterprise CI matrix already has a Traces shard (ci_matrix.ent.json appends service-graph.spec.js to it). The Navbar changes (ONavGroup, navGroups) support the flyout highlight behavior for the same Traces area.
rationale.group: Traces — the enterprise CI matrix (ci_matrix.ent.json) has an append entry for "Traces": ["service-graph.spec.js"], confirming the Traces shard exists in the OSS base matrix. The new traces-toolbar-tabs.spec.js naturally belongs in the same shard alongside the existing service-graph.spec.js, both exercising in-page Service Graph / Services Catalog functionality on the Traces page.
rationale.existing_tests: Yes — a new Playwright E2E spec was authored in this diff: tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Traces/traces-toolbar-tabs.spec.js (103 lines, 4 test cases covering Service Graph tab, Services Catalog tab, search context carry + reload restore, and rail flyout standalone route). This is a full E2E spec under the Playwright tests directory, not a Vitest unit test. The changed Vitest/unit spec files (ONavGroup.spec.ts, Index.spec.ts, SearchBar.spec.ts) are unit-level coverage for the Navbar and Traces components — they are not Playwright E2E specs and do not count as existing E2E coverage.
